verdict.rationale: PostHog documents HogQL, a SQL-like query language, that lets developers directly query raw events with SELECT/FROM/JOIN/WHERE/GROUP BY, and also join across data warehouse sources alongside events/persons/sessions in one SQL query, plus MCP/agent access to run HogQL queries. This is well-documented first-party capability with clear syntax examples. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of SQL query correctness/performance at scale (one community comment notes LLM confusion with cohorts, not the SQL feature itself).
